title: People across Varginha report seeing spaceships

tellings.quote: Yes. If you walk throughout the city, there are always reports of people who have seen spaceships.

plain: In the Brazilian city of Varginha, sightings are said to be everywhere: according to a surgeon named Ahmed Foratu, whose hospital he says once operated on an alien, if you walk through the city 'there are always reports of people who have seen spaceships'. He tells Michels this as what the townspeople say, which would make Varginha a place where seeing craft is part of ordinary local talk.
